ko.B: 일어나서 백성을 거룩하게 구별하여라. 그들에게 말하여라. '내일을 위하여 너희 자신을 거룩하게 구별하여라. 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. "이스라엘아, 너희 가운데 진멸할 물건이 있다. 너희 가운데에서 그 진멸할 물건을 없애기 전에는 너희가 원수들에게 맞설 수 없다."
ko.R: 일어나서 백성을 거룩하게 하여라. 그들에게 말하여라. '너희 자신을 거룩하게 하고 내일을 준비하여라. 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. "이스라엘아, 너희 가운데 진멸할 물건이 있다. 그것을 없애기 전에는 너희가 원수들에게 맞설 수 없을 것이다."

pt.L: Levanta-te, santifica o povo e diz: 'Santifiquem-se para amanhã, pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel: "[Há] uma coisa consagrada no meio de ti, Israel; não poderás ficar de pé diante dos teus inimigos até que vocês removam a coisa consagrada do meio de vocês."
pt.B: Levanta-te e santifica o povo. Diz-lhes: 'Santifiquem-se para amanhã, porque assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel: "Há coisas consagradas no teu meio, Israel. Não poderás resistir aos teus inimigos enquanto não as tirares do teu meio."
pt.R: Levanta-te e torna o povo santo. Diz a eles: 'Tornem-se santos e preparem-se para amanhã. Pois isto é o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, diz: "Israel, há coisas consagradas no meio de ti. Não vais conseguir resistir aos teus inimigos enquanto não te livrares delas."

decisions.choice: consecrate: make the people ready to come before the LORD
decisions.reason: To consecrate the people was to make them ready to meet God, usually by washing and keeping themselves clean (Exodus 19:10-15; Joshua 3:5). The next day the LORD himself would point out the guilty one.

decisions.choice: the message Joshua is to give runs from here to the end of verse 15
decisions.reason: The LORD tells Joshua what to say to the people. That message begins here, includes the LORD's own words ("thus says the LORD"), and goes on to the instructions for the next morning in verses 14-15, which speak to the people as "you" (plural).

decisions.choice: a devoted thing: the stolen goods from Jericho, still under the ban
decisions.reason: The singular noun names the devoted goods as a whole, as in verse 1. While they remain in the camp, the whole people is touched by the ban (verse 12).

decisions.choice: make ... holy
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate" with the plainer "make holy", and adds "get ready" for the purpose (m1).

decisions.choice: quotation marks: the LORD's words inside Joshua's message inside the LORD's speech
decisions.reason: The LORD's speech to Joshua (from verse 10) takes double quotation marks; the message Joshua is to give takes single marks; the words "thus says the LORD" introduce a third level, in double marks again, which ends with this verse. The single marks stay open to the end of verse 15 (m2).

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel in the LORD's words; plural for "conságrense / consagraos"
decisions.reason: In the LORD's message the Hebrew speaks to Israel as one person ("in your midst, Israel; you will not be able"), and Spanish keeps "tú" there. The command to consecrate themselves is plural, as is verse 14.

decisions.choice: « » for the LORD's speech, “ ” for Joshua's message inside it, and ‘ ’ for the LORD's words inside that message
decisions.reason: French puts « » outside and “ ” inside; a third level is rare, and the curved single quotes ‘ ’ are the usual way to mark it, as the English uses double, single and double again.

decisions.choice: ti, poderás, teus ... vocês removam, de vocês (L); tu through the sentence (B, R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's words to Israel begin in the singular, Israel as one people, and end in the plural ("until you remove ... from your midst"). Literal follows the Hebrew number word by word; Balanced and Readable keep the singular of the main clause through the sentence, so that no sentence mixes "tu" and "vocês", the rule Deuteronomy sets (Deuteronomy 4:1; 6:1). Joshua's message to the people (verses 13-15) is in the plural, "vocês".

source.text: וְנִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם בַּבֹּ֖קֶר לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָ֡ה הַשֵּׁבֶט֩ אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶ֨נּוּ יְהוָ֜ה יִקְרַ֣ב לַמִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֞ה אֲשֶֽׁר־יִלְכְּדֶ֤נָּה יְהוָה֙ תִּקְרַ֣ב לַבָּתִּ֔ים וְהַבַּ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִלְכְּדֶ֣נּוּ יְהוָ֔ה יִקְרַ֖ב לַגְּבָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will come near in the morning by your tribes; and it will be the tribe which takes it Yahweh will come near by the clans, and the clan which takes it Yahweh will come near by the households, and the household which takes it Yahweh will come near by the men.

en.L: And you will be brought near in the morning by your tribes; and it shall be [that] the tribe that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes shall come near by clans, and the clan that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes shall come near by households, and the household that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes shall come near man by man.
en.B: In the morning you are to come forward tribe by tribe. The tribe that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} picks out is to come forward clan by clan. The clan that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} picks out is to come forward household by household, and the household that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} picks out is to come forward man by man.
en.R: In the morning, come forward one tribe at a time. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will show which tribe it is. Then that tribe will come forward one clan at a time. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will show which clan it is. That clan will come forward one family at a time. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will show which family it is. Then that family will come forward one man at a time.

sw.L: Mtaletwa karibu asubuhi kwa kabila zenu; na itakuwa kabila ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalitwaa litakaribia kwa koo, na ukoo ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atautwaa utakaribia kwa jamaa, na jamaa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataitwaa itakaribia mtu mmoja mmoja.
sw.B: Asubuhi mtajitokeza kabila kwa kabila. Kabila ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalichagua litajitokeza ukoo kwa ukoo. Ukoo ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atauchagua utajitokeza jamaa kwa jamaa, na jamaa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataichagua itajitokeza mtu mmoja mmoja.
sw.R: Asubuhi, jitokezeni kabila moja baada ya jingine. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataonyesha ni kabila lipi. Kisha kabila hilo litajitokeza ukoo mmoja baada ya mwingine. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataonyesha ni ukoo upi. Ukoo huo utajitokeza jamaa moja baada ya nyingine. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataonyesha ni jamaa ipi. Kisha jamaa hiyo itajitokeza mtu mmoja mmoja.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:se acercarán|os acercaréis}} por la mañana por {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}}; y sucederá que la tribu que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tome se acercará por clanes, y el clan que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tome se acercará por familias, y la familia que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tome se acercará hombre por hombre.
es.B: Por la mañana {{plural_you:se presentarán|os presentaréis}} tribu por tribu. La tribu que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} señale se presentará clan por clan. El clan que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} señale se presentará familia por familia, y la familia que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} señale se presentará hombre por hombre.
es.R: Por la mañana, {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} tribu por tribu. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mostrará cuál es la tribu. Luego esa tribu se presentará clan por clan. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mostrará cuál es el clan. Ese clan se presentará familia por familia. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mostrará cuál es la familia. Luego esa familia se presentará hombre por hombre.

fr.L: Et vous vous approcherez au matin par vos tribus ; et il arrivera [que] la tribu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra s’approchera par clans, et le clan que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra s’approchera par familles, et la famille que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra s’approchera homme par homme.
fr.B: Au matin, vous vous présenterez tribu par tribu. La tribu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} désignera se présentera clan par clan. Le clan que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} désignera se présentera famille par famille, et la famille que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} désignera se présentera homme par homme.
fr.R: Au matin, présentez-vous une tribu après l’autre. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera de quelle tribu il s’agit. Ensuite, cette tribu se présentera un clan après l’autre. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera de quel clan il s’agit. Ce clan se présentera une famille après l’autre. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera de quelle famille il s’agit. Puis cette famille se présentera un homme après l’autre.

vi.L: Và sáng mai các ngươi sẽ được đem đến gần theo từng chi tộc; và chi tộc nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bắt thăm trúng sẽ đến gần theo từng gia tộc, và gia tộc nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bắt trúng sẽ đến gần theo từng nhà, và nhà nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bắt trúng sẽ đến gần từng người một.
vi.B: Sáng mai các ngươi phải đến trình diện theo từng chi tộc. Chi tộc nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chỉ ra sẽ đến theo từng gia tộc. Gia tộc nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chỉ ra sẽ đến theo từng nhà, và nhà nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chỉ ra sẽ đến từng người một.
vi.R: Sáng mai, các ngươi hãy đến trình diện từng chi tộc một. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chỉ ra chi tộc nào. Rồi chi tộc ấy sẽ đến từng gia tộc một. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chỉ ra gia tộc nào. Gia tộc ấy sẽ đến từng gia đình một. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chỉ ra gia đình nào. Rồi gia đình ấy sẽ đến từng người một.

ko.L: 너희는 아침에 지파별로 가까이 나오너라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 뽑으시는 지파는 가문별로 가까이 나오고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 뽑으시는 가문은 집안별로 가까이 나오고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 뽑으시는 집안은 남자 한 사람씩 가까이 나와야 한다.
ko.B: 아침에 너희는 지파별로 앞으로 나와야 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 뽑으시는 지파는 가문별로 나오고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 뽑으시는 가문은 집안별로 나오고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 뽑으시는 집안은 남자 한 사람씩 나와야 한다.
ko.R: 아침에 한 지파씩 앞으로 나오너라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어느 지파인지 보여 주실 것이다. 그러면 그 지파가 한 가문씩 앞으로 나와야 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어느 가문인지 보여 주실 것이다. 그 가문은 한 집안씩 나와야 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어느 집안인지 보여 주실 것이다. 그러면 그 집안은 남자 한 사람씩 나와야 한다.

pt.L: E vocês se aproximarão pela manhã segundo as suas tribos; e será que a tribo que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tomar se aproximará por clãs, e o clã que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tomar se aproximará por famílias, e a família que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tomar se aproximará homem por homem.
pt.B: Pela manhã vocês devem se apresentar tribo por tribo. A tribo que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} indicar deve se apresentar clã por clã. O clã que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} indicar deve se apresentar família por família, e a família que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} indicar deve se apresentar homem por homem.
pt.R: Pela manhã, venham à frente, uma tribo de cada vez. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai mostrar qual é a tribo. Depois essa tribo virá à frente, um clã de cada vez. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai mostrar qual é o clã. Esse clã virá à frente, uma família de cada vez. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai mostrar qual é a família. Depois essa família virá à frente, um homem de cada vez.

decisions.choice: takes: selects by lot
decisions.reason: The verb means "capture" or "seize", and is used for choosing someone by lot (1 Samuel 10:20-21; 14:41-42). The text does not say how the lot was cast; it may have been with the Urim and Thummim kept by the priest (Numbers 27:21; 1 Samuel 14:41). Either way, the choice is the LORD's.

decisions.choice: tribes, clans, households, men: the steps of Israel's family structure
decisions.reason: Israel was made up of tribes, each tribe of clans, each clan of households ("father's houses"), each household of its men. The lot narrows the search step by step, as verses 16-18 then show.

decisions.choice: picks out / will show which
decisions.reason: "Take" in the sense of choosing by lot (m1) is put as "picks out" at Balanced and "will show which" at Readable; Literal keeps "takes".

decisions.choice: family
decisions.reason: Readable uses "family" for the household, the group under one head; "clan" stays for the larger group.

decisions.choice: "bắt thăm trúng", "bắt trúng" (L), "chỉ ra" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The LORD "takes" by the lot (m1). Literal names the lot once, with "thăm", the word the terms note sets for lot in these books; Balanced and Readable say what the lot does, "point out".

decisions.choice: tomar (L); indicar (B); mostrar qual é (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to seize, and here to pick out by lot (m1). Literal keeps "tomar", as the English Literal keeps "take"; Balanced says "indicar", and Readable "vai mostrar qual é", as the English Readable does; the same in verses 16-18, where Readable says "foi escolhido" as the English does. The household (bayit) is "a família" at every level, as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md has it.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ הַנִּלְכָּ֣ד בַּחֵ֔רֶם יִשָּׂרֵ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ אֹת֖וֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ כִּ֤י עָבַר֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְכִֽי־עָשָׂ֥ה נְבָלָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be the one taken with the devoted thing will be burned with fire, he and all that [belongs] to him, for he has transgressed [the] covenant of Yahweh and for he has done a disgraceful folly in Israel.

en.L: And it shall be [that] the one taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that [is] his, because he has transgressed the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and because he has done an outrageous folly in Israel.'"
en.B: The one who is picked out with the devoted things is to be burned, he and everything he has, because he has broken the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and has done a shameful thing in Israel.'"
en.R: The man who is shown to have the devoted things must be burned with fire, along with everything he owns. He has broken {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant and done a shameful thing in Israel.'"

sw.L: Na itakuwa yule atakayetwaliwa akiwa na kitu kilichowekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi atateketezwa kwa moto, yeye na vyote alivyo navyo, kwa sababu amelivunja agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kwa sababu amefanya upumbavu wa aibu katika Israeli.'"
sw.B: Yule atakayechaguliwa akiwa na vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi atachomwa moto, yeye na vyote alivyo navyo, kwa sababu amelivunja agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kufanya jambo la aibu katika Israeli.'"
sw.R: Mtu atakayeonyeshwa kuwa na vitu hivyo vilivyowekwa wakfu lazima achomwe moto, pamoja na kila kitu alicho nacho. Amelivunja agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kufanya jambo la aibu katika Israeli.'"

es.L: Y sucederá que el que sea tomado con lo consagrado al exterminio será quemado con fuego, él y todo lo que [es] suyo, porque ha quebrantado el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y porque ha cometido una infamia en Israel”».
es.B: El que sea señalado con lo consagrado al exterminio será quemado, él y todo lo que tiene, porque ha quebrantado el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y ha cometido una infamia en Israel”».
es.R: El hombre que resulte tener las cosas consagradas al exterminio será quemado con fuego, junto con todo lo que tiene. Ha roto el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y ha hecho algo vergonzoso en Israel”».

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] celui qui sera pris avec l’interdit sera brûlé au feu, lui et tout ce qui [est] à lui, parce qu’il a transgressé l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et parce qu’il a commis une infamie en Israël.” »
fr.B: Celui qui sera désigné avec les choses vouées à l’interdit sera brûlé, lui et tout ce qu’il possède, parce qu’il a rompu l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et qu’il a commis une chose honteuse en Israël.” »
fr.R: L’homme qui sera désigné comme ayant les choses vouées à l’interdit devra être brûlé, avec tout ce qu’il possède. Il a rompu l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et il a fait une chose honteuse en Israël.” »

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, kẻ bị bắt trúng với vật bị nguyền để hủy diệt sẽ bị thiêu bằng lửa, nó và mọi vật [thuộc] về nó, vì nó đã vi phạm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và vì nó đã làm điều xấu xa ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.'"
vi.B: Kẻ bị chỉ ra là đã giữ các vật phải bị tận diệt sẽ bị thiêu, nó và mọi vật nó có, vì nó đã vi phạm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đã làm điều ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.'"
vi.R: Kẻ bị chỉ ra là đã giữ những vật phải bị hủy diệt sẽ bị thiêu bằng lửa, cùng với mọi vật nó có. Nó đã vi phạm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đã làm điều ô nhục trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.'"

ko.L: 그리고 진멸할 물건을 가진 자로 뽑힌 사람은, 그와 그에게 속한 모든 것을 불로 태울 것이다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약을 어겼고, 이스라엘 안에서 망령된 일을 저질렀기 때문이다.'"
ko.B: 진멸할 물건을 가진 자로 뽑힌 사람은 그와 그에게 속한 모든 것을 불태워야 한다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약을 어기고 이스라엘 안에서 수치스러운 일을 저질렀기 때문이다.'"
ko.R: 진멸할 물건을 가진 것으로 드러난 사람은 그가 가진 모든 것과 함께 불태워야 한다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약을 깨뜨리고, 이스라엘 안에서 부끄러운 일을 저질렀기 때문이다.'"

pt.L: E será que aquele que for tomado com a coisa consagrada será queimado no fogo, ele e tudo o que [é] dele, porque transgrediu a aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e porque cometeu uma infâmia em Israel.'"
pt.B: Aquele que for indicado com as coisas consagradas deve ser queimado, ele e tudo o que tem, porque quebrou a aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e fez uma coisa vergonhosa em Israel.'"
pt.R: O homem que for apontado como quem tem as coisas consagradas deve ser queimado no fogo, junto com tudo o que tem. Ele quebrou a aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e fez uma coisa vergonhosa em Israel.'"

decisions.choice: burned with fire: the way devoted things were destroyed
decisions.reason: A town or thing devoted to the LORD was burned (6:24; Deuteronomy 13:17). The one who took devoted things has become devoted himself (verse 12), so he and what he has are to be destroyed in the same way. Verse 25 tells how it was carried out.

decisions.choice: all that is his: his possessions, and perhaps his household
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean property only, or all that belonged to a man, including his household. Verse 24 lists his sons and daughters with his animals and tent; see the note there.

decisions.choice: outrageous folly: a shameful act that breaks the bonds of the community
decisions.reason: The word does not mean simple foolishness but a disgraceful act that the community must not tolerate, used of rape and of grave sexual wrong (Genesis 34:7; Deuteronomy 22:21; Judges 20:6). Here it is betraying the LORD and the whole people.

decisions.choice: a shameful thing
decisions.reason: "Folly" sounds mild to modern ears. Balanced and Readable use "shameful" to carry the weight of the word (m3).

decisions.choice: uma infâmia (L); uma coisa vergonhosa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word names a disgraceful act the community cannot tolerate (m3). "Loucura" would sound like simple madness; Literal says "infâmia", and Balanced and Readable "uma coisa vergonhosa", as the English says "a shameful thing" (r-en-1).

source.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִשְׁבָטָ֑יו וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose early Joshua in the morning and brought near Israel by its tribes, and was taken [the] tribe of Judah.

en.L: And Joshua rose early in the morning and brought Israel near by its tribes, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
en.B: Joshua rose early the next morning and brought Israel forward by tribes. The tribe of Judah was picked out.
en.R: Joshua got up early the next morning. He had Israel come forward one tribe at a time, and the tribe of Judah was chosen.

sw.L: Yoshua akaamka mapema asubuhi, akawaleta Israeli karibu kwa kabila zao, na kabila la Yuda likatwaliwa.
sw.B: Yoshua aliamka mapema asubuhi iliyofuata, akawaleta Israeli mbele kabila kwa kabila. Kabila la Yuda likachaguliwa.
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, Yoshua aliamka. Aliwafanya Israeli wajitokeze kabila moja baada ya jingine, na kabila la Yuda likachaguliwa.

es.L: Y Josué se levantó temprano por la mañana e hizo acercar a Israel por sus tribus, y fue tomada la tribu de Judá.
es.B: Josué se levantó temprano a la mañana siguiente e hizo que Israel se presentara por tribus. Fue señalada la tribu de Judá.
es.R: Josué se levantó temprano a la mañana siguiente. Hizo que Israel se presentara tribu por tribu, y fue escogida la tribu de Judá.

fr.L: Et Josué se leva de bon matin et fit approcher Israël par tribus, et la tribu de Juda fut prise.
fr.B: Josué se leva de bon matin et fit avancer Israël tribu par tribu. La tribu de Juda fut désignée.
fr.R: Le lendemain, Josué s’est levé tôt. Il a fait avancer Israël une tribu après l’autre, et c’est la tribu de Juda qui a été choisie.

vi.L: Và Giô-suê dậy sớm vào buổi sáng và đem Y-sơ-ra-ên đến gần theo từng chi tộc, và chi tộc Giu-đa bị bắt trúng.
vi.B: Sáng hôm sau Giô-suê dậy sớm và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên đến trình diện theo từng chi tộc. Chi tộc Giu-đa bị chỉ ra.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau, Giô-suê thức dậy. Ông cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đến trình diện từng chi tộc một, và chi tộc Giu-đa bị chỉ ra.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 아침 일찍 일어나 이스라엘을 지파별로 가까이 나오게 하니, 유다 지파가 뽑혔다.
ko.B: 다음 날 아침 여호수아는 일찍 일어나 이스라엘을 지파별로 앞으로 나오게 했다. 유다 지파가 뽑혔다.
ko.R: 다음 날 아침 여호수아는 일찍 일어났다. 그는 이스라엘이 한 지파씩 앞으로 나오게 했고, 유다 지파가 뽑혔다.

pt.L: E Josué se levantou cedo pela manhã e fez Israel se aproximar segundo as suas tribos, e foi tomada a tribo de Judá.
pt.B: Josué se levantou cedo na manhã seguinte e fez Israel se apresentar por tribos. A tribo de Judá foi indicada.
pt.R: Josué se levantou cedo na manhã seguinte. Ele fez Israel vir à frente, uma tribo de cada vez, e a tribo de Judá foi escolhida.

decisions.choice: rose early: Joshua acted at once
decisions.reason: "Rising early" often marks prompt obedience (3:1; 6:12; Genesis 22:3). Joshua does exactly as the LORD said in verse 14.

decisions.choice: was picked out / was chosen
decisions.reason: As in verse 14, "taken" means chosen by lot.

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּלְכֹּ֕ד אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַזַּרְחִ֑י וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַזַּרְחִי֙ לַגְּבָרִ֔ים וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד זַבְדִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought near [the] clan of Judah, and he took [the] clan of the Zerahite; and he brought near [the] clan of the Zerahite by the men, and was taken Zabdi.

en.L: And he brought near the clan of Judah, and he took the clan of the Zerahites; and he brought near the clan of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was taken.
en.B: He brought forward the clans of Judah, and the Zerahite clan was picked out. He brought forward the Zerahite clan man by man, and Zabdi was picked out.
en.R: Next the clans of Judah came forward, and the clan of Zerah was chosen. Then the clan of Zerah came forward man by man, and Zabdi was chosen.

sw.L: Akaleta karibu ukoo wa Yuda, akautwaa ukoo wa Wazera; akaleta karibu ukoo wa Wazera mtu mmoja mmoja, na Zabdi akatwaliwa.
sw.B: Aliziita mbele koo za Yuda, na ukoo wa Wazera ukachaguliwa. Akauita mbele ukoo wa Wazera mtu mmoja mmoja, na Zabdi akachaguliwa.
sw.R: Kisha koo za Yuda zilijitokeza, na ukoo wa Zera ukachaguliwa. Kisha ukoo wa Zera ukajitokeza mtu mmoja mmoja, na Zabdi akachaguliwa.

es.L: E hizo acercar al clan de Judá, y tomó al clan de los zeraítas; e hizo acercar al clan de los zeraítas hombre por hombre, y fue tomado Zabdi.
es.B: Hizo presentarse a los clanes de Judá, y fue señalado el clan de los zeraítas. Hizo presentarse al clan de los zeraítas hombre por hombre, y fue señalado Zabdi.
es.R: Después se presentaron los clanes de Judá, y fue escogido el clan de Zara. Luego el clan de Zara se presentó hombre por hombre, y fue escogido Zabdi.

fr.L: Et il fit approcher le clan de Juda, et il prit le clan des Zérahites ; et il fit approcher le clan des Zérahites homme par homme, et Zabdi fut pris.
fr.B: Il fit avancer les clans de Juda, et le clan des Zérahites fut désigné. Il fit avancer le clan des Zérahites homme par homme, et Zabdi fut désigné.
fr.R: Ensuite, les clans de Juda se sont avancés, et le clan de Zérah a été choisi. Puis le clan de Zérah s’est avancé, homme après homme, et Zabdi a été choisi.

vi.L: Và ông đem gia tộc Giu-đa đến gần, và bắt trúng gia tộc Xê-rách; và ông đem gia tộc Xê-rách đến gần từng người một, và Xáp-đi bị bắt trúng.
vi.B: Ông cho các gia tộc Giu-đa đến trình diện, và gia tộc Xê-rách bị chỉ ra. Ông cho gia tộc Xê-rách đến trình diện từng người một, và Xáp-đi bị chỉ ra.
vi.R: Rồi các gia tộc Giu-đa đến trình diện, và gia tộc Xê-rách bị chỉ ra. Sau đó gia tộc Xê-rách đến trình diện từng người một, và Xáp-đi bị chỉ ra.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 유다 가문을 가까이 나오게 하니, 세라 가문이 뽑혔다. 그리고 그가 세라 가문을 남자 한 사람씩 가까이 나오게 하니, 삽디가 뽑혔다.
ko.B: 그가 유다의 가문들을 앞으로 나오게 하니, 세라 가문이 뽑혔다. 그가 세라 가문을 남자 한 사람씩 나오게 하니, 삽디가 뽑혔다.
ko.R: 다음에는 유다의 가문들이 앞으로 나왔고, 세라 가문이 뽑혔다. 그다음에는 세라 가문이 남자 한 사람씩 나왔고, 삽디가 뽑혔다.

pt.L: E fez se aproximar o clã de Judá, e tomou o clã dos zeraítas; e fez se aproximar o clã dos zeraítas homem por homem, e foi tomado Zabdi.
pt.B: Ele fez os clãs de Judá se apresentarem, e o clã dos zeraítas foi indicado. Fez o clã dos zeraítas se apresentar homem por homem, e Zabdi foi indicado.
pt.R: Em seguida os clãs de Judá vieram à frente, e o clã de Zerá foi escolhido. Depois o clã de Zerá veio à frente, homem por homem, e Zabdi foi escolhido.

decisions.choice: the clan of Judah: the clans of Judah
alternatives: the clan of Judah (the tribe as a whole)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has the singular "clan of Judah", which would mean the tribe taken as a whole. The Greek translation and a few Hebrew manuscripts have the plural "the clans of Judah", which fits the steps of verse 14. The sense is the same either way: Judah's clans were brought forward in turn.

decisions.choice: man by man: probably household by household
decisions.reason: Verse 14 orders the clan to come forward by households, and Zabdi is the head of a household (verse 18). The Hebrew here reads "by men", perhaps meaning the heads of each household; a few Hebrew manuscripts and the Syriac translation read "by households". Either way the household of Zabdi is the one chosen.

decisions.choice: he took: the LORD chose, through the lot
decisions.reason: The subject of "he took" is not named. It is the LORD, who "takes" by the lot (verse 14), though it could be read loosely of Joshua casting it.

decisions.choice: the clan of Zerah
decisions.reason: Readable names the clan by its ancestor rather than as "the Zerahites".

records.literal_gloss: And he brought near his household by the men, and was taken Achan son of Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of [the] tribe of Judah.

en.L: And he brought near his household man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
en.B: He had Zabdi's household come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was picked out.
en.R: Then he had Zabdi's family come forward one man at a time, and Achan was chosen. He was the son of Carmi and grandson of Zabdi, from the family line of Zerah in the tribe of Judah.

sw.L: Akaleta karibu jamaa yake mtu mmoja mmoja, na Akani mwana wa Karmi, mwana wa Zabdi, mwana wa Zera, wa kabila la Yuda, akatwaliwa.
sw.B: Aliiita mbele jamaa ya Zabdi mtu mmoja mmoja, na Akani mwana wa Karmi, mwana wa Zabdi, mwana wa Zera, wa kabila la Yuda, akachaguliwa.
sw.R: Kisha akaifanya jamaa ya Zabdi ijitokeze mtu mmoja mmoja, na Akani akachaguliwa. Alikuwa mwana wa Karmi na mjukuu wa Zabdi, wa ukoo wa Zera katika kabila la Yuda.

es.L: E hizo acercar a su familia hombre por hombre, y fue tomado Acán hijo de Carmi, hijo de Zabdi, hijo de Zara, de la tribu de Judá.
es.B: Hizo presentarse a la familia de Zabdi hombre por hombre, y fue señalado Acán hijo de Carmi, hijo de Zabdi, hijo de Zara, de la tribu de Judá.
es.R: Luego hizo que la familia de Zabdi se presentara hombre por hombre, y fue escogido Acán. Era hijo de Carmi y nieto de Zabdi, de la descendencia de Zara, en la tribu de Judá.

fr.L: Et il fit approcher sa maison homme par homme, et Akân fils de Karmi, fils de Zabdi, fils de Zérah, de la tribu de Juda, fut pris.
fr.B: Il fit avancer la famille de Zabdi homme par homme, et Akân fils de Karmi, fils de Zabdi, fils de Zérah, de la tribu de Juda, fut désigné.
fr.R: Ensuite, il a fait avancer la famille de Zabdi, un homme après l’autre, et Akân a été choisi. Il était fils de Karmi et petit-fils de Zabdi, de la famille de Zérah, dans la tribu de Juda.

vi.L: Và ông đem nhà người đến gần từng người một, và A-can, con trai Cạt-mi, con trai Xáp-đi, con trai Xê-rách, thuộc chi tộc Giu-đa, bị bắt trúng.
vi.B: Ông cho nhà Xáp-đi đến trình diện từng người một, và A-can, con trai Cạt-mi, con trai Xáp-đi, con trai Xê-rách, thuộc chi tộc Giu-đa, bị chỉ ra.
vi.R: Rồi ông cho gia đình Xáp-đi đến trình diện từng người một, và A-can bị chỉ ra. Ông là con trai Cạt-mi và cháu Xáp-đi, thuộc dòng họ Xê-rách trong chi tộc Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 집안을 남자 한 사람씩 가까이 나오게 하니, 유다 지파 세라의 아들 삽디의 아들 갈미의 아들 아간이 뽑혔다.
ko.B: 그가 삽디의 집안을 남자 한 사람씩 나오게 하니, 유다 지파 사람으로 세라의 아들 삽디의 아들 갈미의 아들인 아간이 뽑혔다.
ko.R: 그다음에 여호수아는 삽디의 집안을 남자 한 사람씩 나오게 했고, 아간이 뽑혔다. 아간은 갈미의 아들이고 삽디의 손자로, 유다 지파 세라 집안 사람이었다.

pt.L: E fez se aproximar a sua família homem por homem, e foi tomado Acã, filho de Carmi, filho de Zabdi, filho de Zerá, da tribo de Judá.
pt.B: Fez a família de Zabdi se apresentar homem por homem, e foi indicado Acã, filho de Carmi, filho de Zabdi, filho de Zerá, da tribo de Judá.
pt.R: Então ele fez a família de Zabdi vir à frente, um homem de cada vez, e Acã foi escolhido. Ele era filho de Carmi e neto de Zabdi, dos descendentes de Zerá, na tribo de Judá.

decisions.choice: his household: the household of Zabdi
decisions.reason: "His" points back to Zabdi, the last one named in verse 17. The lot has now narrowed from all Israel to one man, and the full line of descent from verse 1 is repeated to show that the LORD has found the very man.

decisions.choice: Zabdi's household / Zabdi's family
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name whose household is meant (m1). Readable uses "family" for the household, as in verse 14, and explains the line of descent as in verse 1.

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to Achan, My son, put please glory to Yahweh, God of Israel, and give to him confession; and tell please to me what you have done; do not hide from me.

en.L: And Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory, please, to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, and give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} praise; and tell me, please, what you have done. Do not hide [it] from me."
en.B: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory now to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. Make your confession to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Tell me what you have done. Do not hide anything from me."
en.R: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, by telling the truth. Confess to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Tell me what you did. Do not hide anything from me."

sw.L: Yoshua akamwambia Akani, "Mwanangu, tafadhali mpe utukufu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, na umpe sifa; tafadhali niambie ulichofanya. Usinifiche."
sw.B: Kisha Yoshua alimwambia Akani, "Mwanangu, mpe sasa utukufu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli. Ungama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Niambie ulichofanya. Usinifiche chochote."
sw.R: Kisha Yoshua alimwambia Akani, "Mwanangu, mheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa kusema ukweli. Ungama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Niambie ulichofanya. Usinifiche chochote."

es.L: Y Josué dijo a Acán: «Hijo mío, da gloria, te ruego, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, y dale alabanza a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; y dime, te ruego, qué has hecho. No [me lo] ocultes».
es.B: Entonces Josué le dijo a Acán: «Hijo mío, da ahora gloria {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel. Haz tu confesión ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Dime qué has hecho. No me ocultes nada».
es.R: Entonces Josué le dijo a Acán: «Hijo mío, honra {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, diciendo la verdad. Confiésate ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Dime qué hiciste. No me ocultes nada».

fr.L: Et Josué dit à Akân : « Mon fils, donne donc gloire {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, et rends-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} louange ; et dis-moi donc ce que tu as fait. Ne [me le] cache pas. »
fr.B: Alors Josué dit à Akân : « Mon fils, rends gloire {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. Fais-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ta confession. Dis-moi ce que tu as fait. Ne me cache rien. »
fr.R: Alors Josué a dit à Akân : « Mon fils, honore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, en disant la vérité. Avoue-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ta faute. Dis-moi ce que tu as fait. Ne me cache rien. »

vi.L: Và Giô-suê nói với A-can: "Con ơi, hãy dâng vinh quang cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, và ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; và hãy nói cho ta biết con đã làm gì. Đừng giấu ta."
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-suê nói với A-can: "Con ơi, bây giờ hãy dâng vinh quang cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy xưng tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy nói cho ta biết con đã làm gì. Đừng giấu ta điều gì."
vi.R: Rồi Giô-suê nói với A-can: "Con ơi, hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, bằng cách nói thật. Hãy xưng tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy nói cho ta biết con đã làm gì. Đừng giấu ta điều gì."

ko.L: 그러자 여호수아가 아간에게 말했다. "내 아들아, 부디 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영광을 돌리고 그분께 찬양을 드려라. 그리고 네가 무엇을 했는지 부디 나에게 말하여라. 나에게 숨기지 마라."

ko.R: 그때 여호수아가 아간에게 말했다. "내 아들아, 사실대로 말해서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영광을 돌려라. 그분께 네 죄를 고백하여라. 네가 무엇을 했는지 나에게 말하여라. 아무것도 숨기지 마라."

pt.L: E Josué disse a Acã: "Meu filho, dê glória, por favor, {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, e dê-{{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} louvor; e conte-me, por favor, o que você fez. Não [o] esconda de mim."
pt.B: Então Josué disse a Acã: "Meu filho, dê agora glória {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de Israel. Faça a sua confissão a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Conte-me o que você fez. Não esconda nada de mim."
pt.R: Então Josué disse a Acã: "Meu filho, honre {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, dizendo a verdade. Confesse tudo a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Diga-me o que você fez. Não esconda nada de mim."

decisions.choice: give glory to the LORD: honor God by telling the whole truth
decisions.reason: This was a solemn call to speak the truth before God, who already knows it (John 9:24 uses the same words). To confess one's guilt is to admit that God's judgment is right, and so to give him glory.

decisions.choice: praise / confession: the word means both
decisions.reason: The noun means thanks or praise given to God, and also acknowledging something before him. Here it means confessing the wrong (Ezra 10:11 uses it with the same verb for confessing sin). Achan's confession acknowledges that the LORD has judged truly.

decisions.choice: my son: a kind but serious address
decisions.reason: An older man or leader could call a younger one "my son" (1 Samuel 3:6; 2 Samuel 18:22). Joshua speaks gently while asking for a confession that will cost Achan his life.

decisions.choice: make your confession / Confess
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the sense of confessing the wrong (m2). Literal keeps "praise", the word's common meaning, so readers see the link with giving glory.

decisions.choice: honor the LORD ... by telling the truth
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom of giving glory (m1) instead of reproducing it.

decisions.choice: Joshua calls Achan "con" and himself "ta"; Achan answers as "con"
decisions.reason: Joshua's "my son" is kind but grave (m3), the address of an older man to a younger. Vietnamese carries it through the exchange: Joshua "ta", Achan "con", and Achan answers in the same terms (verses 20-21).

decisions.choice: Joshua speaks to Achan in the plain style with "내 아들아"; Achan answers in the formal polite style
decisions.reason: Joshua calls Achan "my son", a kind but serious address from an older leader, so Korean keeps the address and the plain style of a father to a son; Achan answers his leader with respect.

decisions.choice: Meu filho ... você
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks to Achan as an older leader to a younger man (m3): "Meu filho" with "você", the form people use with each other; "tu" is kept for speech to God.

decisions.choice: truly, I have sinned: a full admission
decisions.reason: Achan does not excuse himself. "Truly" stresses that what Joshua suspects is true, and "I" is written out for emphasis: it was he who sinned, and against the LORD himself.

decisions.choice: thus and thus I have done: this is what I did
decisions.reason: The doubled "thus" introduces the full account that follows in verse 21.

source.text: וָאֵ֣רֶא בַשָּׁלָ֡ל אַדֶּ֣רֶת שִׁנְעָר֩ אַחַ֨ת טוֹבָ֜ה וּמָאתַ֧יִם שְׁקָלִ֣ים כֶּ֗סֶף וּלְשׁ֨וֹן זָהָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים שְׁקָלִים֙ מִשְׁקָל֔וֹ וָֽאֶחְמְדֵ֖ם וָֽאֶקָּחֵ֑ם וְהִנָּ֨ם טְמוּנִ֥ים בָּאָ֛רֶץ בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאָֽהֳלִ֖י וְהַכֶּ֥סֶף תַּחְתֶּֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I saw among the spoil a cloak of Shinar, one, good, and two hundred shekels silver, and a tongue of gold, one, fifty shekels its weight, and I coveted them and took them; and there they [are] hidden in the ground in [the] midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

en.L: When I saw among the spoil a fine cloak from Shinar, and 200 shekels of silver, and a tongue of gold, fifty shekels [in] its weight, then I coveted them and took them; and see, they [are] hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it."
en.B: Among the spoil I saw a beautiful cloak from Babylonia, {{units:about 5 pounds|200 shekels}} of silver, and a bar of gold weighing {{units:about 1 1/4 pounds|fifty shekels}}. I coveted them and took them, and now they are buried in the ground in the middle of my tent. The silver is at the bottom."
en.R: Among the things we took from Jericho, I saw a beautiful coat from Babylonia, {{units:about 5 pounds|200 shekels}} of silver, and a bar of gold that weighed {{units:about 1 1/4 pounds|fifty shekels}}. I wanted them very much, so I took them. They are buried in the ground in my tent. The silver is at the bottom, under the coat."

sw.L: Nilipoona katika nyara joho zuri la Shinari, na shekeli mia mbili za fedha, na ulimi wa dhahabu, shekeli hamsini uzito wake, ndipo nikavitamani nikavichukua; na tazama, vimefichwa ardhini katikati ya hema langu, na fedha chini yake."
sw.B: Katika nyara niliona joho zuri kutoka Babeli, {{units:kama kilo 2.3|shekeli mia mbili}} za fedha, na kipande cha dhahabu chenye uzito wa {{units:kama gramu 575|shekeli hamsini}}. Nilivitamani, nikavichukua. Sasa vimefukiwa ardhini katikati ya hema langu, na fedha iko chini kabisa."
sw.R: Kati ya vitu tulivyoteka Yeriko, niliona koti zuri kutoka Babeli, {{units:kama kilo 2.3|shekeli mia mbili}} za fedha, na kipande cha dhahabu chenye uzito wa {{units:kama gramu 575|shekeli hamsini}}. Nilivitamani sana, nikavichukua. Vimefukiwa ardhini ndani ya hema langu. Fedha iko chini kabisa, chini ya lile koti."

es.L: Cuando vi entre el botín un manto hermoso de Sinar, y 200 siclos de plata, y una lengua de oro de cincuenta siclos de peso, los codicié y los tomé; y mira, están escondidos en la tierra en medio de mi tienda, y la plata debajo».
es.B: Entre el botín vi un hermoso manto de Babilonia, {{units:unos 2,3 kilos|200 siclos}} de plata y una barra de oro que pesaba {{units:unos 575 gramos|cincuenta siclos}}. Los codicié y los tomé, y ahora están enterrados en medio de mi tienda. La plata está en el fondo».
es.R: Entre las cosas que tomamos en Jericó vi un hermoso manto de Babilonia, {{units:unos 2,3 kilos|200 siclos}} de plata y una barra de oro que pesaba {{units:unos 575 gramos|cincuenta siclos}}. Los deseé mucho, así que los tomé. Están enterrados en mi tienda. La plata está en el fondo, debajo del manto».

fr.L: J’ai vu parmi le butin un beau manteau de Shinéar, et deux cents sicles d’argent, et une langue d’or, de cinquante sicles [de] poids ; je les ai convoités et je les ai pris ; et voici, ils [sont] cachés dans la terre au milieu de ma tente, et l’argent dessous. »
fr.B: J’ai vu parmi le butin un beau manteau de Babylonie, {{units:environ 2,3 kilos|200 sicles}} d’argent et un lingot d’or pesant {{units:environ 575 grammes|cinquante sicles}}. Je les ai convoités et je les ai pris. Ils sont maintenant enfouis dans le sol au milieu de ma tente, l’argent tout au fond. »
fr.R: Parmi les choses que nous avons prises à Jéricho, j’ai vu un beau manteau de Babylonie, {{units:environ 2,3 kilos|200 sicles}} d’argent et un lingot d’or qui pesait {{units:environ 575 grammes|cinquante sicles}}. J’en ai eu très envie, alors je les ai pris. Ils sont enterrés dans le sol, dans ma tente. L’argent est tout au fond, sous le manteau. »

vi.L: Khi con thấy trong của cướp một cái áo choàng tốt đẹp từ Si-nê-a, và 200 siếc-lơ bạc, và một thỏi vàng nặng năm mươi siếc-lơ, thì con tham muốn chúng và lấy chúng; và kìa, chúng được giấu dưới đất ở giữa trại con, và bạc ở dưới."
vi.B: Trong số chiến lợi phẩm, con thấy một cái áo choàng đẹp của Ba-by-lôn, {{units:khoảng 2,3 kg|200 siếc-lơ}} bạc, và một thỏi vàng nặng {{units:khoảng 575 gam|năm mươi siếc-lơ}}. Con tham muốn chúng nên đã lấy. Bây giờ chúng được chôn dưới đất ở giữa lều của con, bạc thì ở dưới cùng."
vi.R: Trong những thứ chúng ta lấy được ở Giê-ri-cô, con thấy một cái áo khoác đẹp của Ba-by-lôn, {{units:khoảng 2,3 kg|200 siếc-lơ}} bạc, và một thỏi vàng nặng {{units:khoảng 575 gam|năm mươi siếc-lơ}}. Con rất thèm muốn chúng, nên con đã lấy. Chúng được chôn dưới đất trong lều của con. Bạc thì ở dưới cùng, dưới cái áo."

ko.L: 제가 전리품 가운데서 좋은 시날 외투 한 벌과 은 이백 세겔과 무게가 오십 세겔 나가는 금 혀 하나를 보았을 때에, 그것들을 탐내어 가졌습니다. 보십시오, 그것들은 제 장막 한가운데 땅속에 감추어져 있고, 은은 그 밑에 있습니다."
ko.B: 저는 전리품 가운데서 바빌로니아에서 만든 아름다운 외투 한 벌과 은 {{units:약 2.3킬로그램|200세겔}}과 무게가 {{units:약 575그램|오십 세겔}} 나가는 금덩이 하나를 보았습니다. 저는 그것들을 탐내어 가졌습니다. 지금 그것들은 제 장막 한가운데 땅속에 묻혀 있고, 은은 맨 밑에 있습니다."
ko.R: 우리가 여리고에서 빼앗은 물건들 가운데서, 저는 바빌로니아에서 만든 아름다운 외투 한 벌과 은 {{units:약 2.3킬로그램|200세겔}}과 무게가 {{units:약 575그램|오십 세겔}} 나가는 금덩이 하나를 보았습니다. 저는 그것들이 너무 갖고 싶어서 가져갔습니다. 그것들은 제 장막 안 땅속에 묻혀 있습니다. 은은 맨 밑, 외투 밑에 있습니다."

pt.L: Vi entre os despojos um belo manto de Sinear, e duzentos siclos de prata, e uma língua de ouro, de cinquenta siclos de peso, e os cobicei e os tomei; e eis que estão escondidos na terra, no meio da minha tenda, e a prata debaixo dele."
pt.B: Entre os despojos eu vi um belo manto da Babilônia, {{units:cerca de 2,3 quilos|duzentos siclos}} de prata e uma barra de ouro de {{units:cerca de 575 gramas|cinquenta siclos}}. Eu os cobicei e os peguei, e agora eles estão enterrados no chão, no meio da minha tenda. A prata está no fundo."
pt.R: Entre as coisas que tomamos em Jericó, eu vi um manto bonito da Babilônia, {{units:cerca de 2,3 quilos|duzentos siclos}} de prata e uma barra de ouro que pesava {{units:cerca de 575 gramas|cinquenta siclos}}. Fiquei com muita vontade de ter essas coisas, por isso as peguei. Elas estão enterradas no chão, na minha tenda. A prata está no fundo, debaixo do manto."

decisions.choice: a cloak from Shinar: a costly robe from Babylonia
decisions.reason: Shinar is the old name of the land of Babylon (Genesis 10:10; 11:2). A fine robe from there was a prized imported luxury, the kind of garment worn by kings (Jonah 3:6 uses the same word for a king's robe).

decisions.choice: 200 shekels of silver; a gold bar of fifty shekels: weights, not coins
decisions.reason: There were no coins yet; silver and gold were weighed. A shekel was about two fifths of an ounce, so the silver weighed about 5 pounds and the gold about 1 1/4 pounds. Both belonged to the LORD's treasury (6:19).

decisions.choice: a tongue of gold: a bar or wedge of gold shaped like a tongue
decisions.reason: The word is "tongue", used here for a long, flat piece of gold, a form in which gold was stored or traded.

decisions.choice: I saw ... I coveted ... I took: the path of the sin
decisions.reason: The three verbs trace the sin from seeing to desiring to taking, as with Eve in the garden (Genesis 3:6). "Covet" is the word of the commandment against coveting (Exodus 20:17), and Moses had warned Israel not to covet the silver and gold of the nations' idols nor bring a devoted thing into their homes (Deuteronomy 7:25-26).

decisions.choice: under it: under the cloak
decisions.reason: "It" is feminine, matching the word for the cloak, not the word for tent. The cloak was laid over the silver in the hole.

decisions.choice: about 5 pounds / about 1 1/4 pounds
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give modern weights, with the shekels as the reader's alternative; Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: Babylonia; a bar of gold
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the land's familiar name and the plain word for the shape (m1, m3). Literal keeps "Shinar" and "tongue".

decisions.choice: the things we took from Jericho
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the spoil" as the goods taken at Jericho, all of which were devoted to the LORD.

decisions.choice: kama kilo 2.3 (the units setting: shekeli mia mbili); kama gramu 575 (the units setting: shekeli hamsini)
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, Swahili gives metric weights by default, reckoning a shekel at 11.5 g, with the shekels as the reader setting.

decisions.choice: metric by default ("environ 2,3 kilos", "environ 575 grammes"), with the shekels ("sicles") as the reader setting
decisions.reason: A shekel weighed about 11.5 g, so 200 shekels are about 2.3 kg and 50 shekels about 575 g, the same values the English gives in pounds. Literal keeps the shekels, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 2,3 kg" and "khoảng 575 gam" by default, "200 siếc-lơ" and "năm mươi siếc-lơ" as the alternatives
decisions.reason: Metric weights with the original unit as the alternative, as the Genesis terms note sets (a shekel is about 11,5 g). Literal keeps "siếc-lơ" with no setting.

decisions.choice: "Si-nê-a" (L), "Ba-by-lôn" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Shinar is the old name for the land of Babylon (m1). Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable give the land readers know, as the English does with "Babylonia".

decisions.choice: metric weights by default: "약 2.3킬로그램" and "약 575그램", the shekels as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set, Korean gives metric measures with the original unit as the alternative, reckoning a shekel at about 11.5 grams; Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: cerca de 2,3 quilos / cerca de 575 gramas, with "duzentos siclos" / "cinquenta siclos" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Portuguese gives metric weights by default, at 11,5 g to the shekel (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), with the shekels as the reader's alternative, where the English default is pounds; Literal keeps the shekels, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: um belo manto de Sinear, uma língua de ouro (L); um belo manto da Babilônia, uma barra de ouro (B); um manto bonito da Babilônia (R)
decisions.reason: "Manto" is the robe a king might wear (m1); "capa" would suggest a cape. Literal keeps the old name "Sinear" (Genesis 10:10 in Portuguese) and the Hebrew "língua"; Balanced and Readable say "Babilônia" and "barra", as the English does (r-en-2). "Debaixo dele" (L) refers to the cloak, as the Hebrew feminine does (m5), since "manto" is masculine.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַיָּרֻ֖צוּ הָאֹ֑הֱלָה וְהִנֵּ֧ה טְמוּנָ֛ה בְּאָהֳל֖וֹ וְהַכֶּ֥סֶף תַּחְתֶּֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Joshua messengers, and they ran to the tent; and there, [it was] hidden in his tent, and the silver under it.

en.L: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and look, [it was] hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.
en.B: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. There it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.
en.R: So Joshua sent some men, and they ran to Achan's tent. The things were there, hidden in his tent, with the silver at the bottom.

sw.L: Yoshua akatuma wajumbe, nao wakakimbia hemani; na tazama, [vilikuwa] vimefichwa katika hema lake, na fedha chini yake.
sw.B: Basi Yoshua alituma wajumbe, nao wakakimbia hemani. Vitu vilikuwa pale, vimefichwa ndani ya hema lake, na fedha chini yake.
sw.R: Basi Yoshua alituma watu, nao wakakimbia kwenye hema la Akani. Vitu vilikuwa pale, vimefichwa ndani ya hema lake, na fedha chini kabisa.

es.L: Y Josué envió mensajeros, y corrieron a la tienda; y he aquí [estaba] escondido en su tienda, y la plata debajo.
es.B: Entonces Josué envió mensajeros, que corrieron a la tienda. Allí estaba, escondido en su tienda, con la plata debajo.
es.R: Entonces Josué envió a unos hombres, que corrieron a la tienda de Acán. Allí estaban las cosas, escondidas en su tienda, con la plata en el fondo.

fr.L: Et Josué envoya des messagers, et ils coururent à la tente ; et voici, [c’était] caché dans sa tente, et l’argent dessous.
fr.B: Josué envoya donc des messagers, qui coururent à la tente. Tout était là, caché dans sa tente, avec l’argent au fond.
fr.R: Josué a donc envoyé quelques hommes, et ils ont couru à la tente d’Akân. Les objets étaient bien là, cachés dans sa tente, avec l’argent tout au fond.

vi.L: Và Giô-suê sai các sứ giả, và họ chạy đến lều; và kìa, [các vật ấy] được giấu trong lều của hắn, và bạc ở dưới.
vi.B: Vậy Giô-suê sai người đi, và họ chạy đến lều. Quả thật các vật ấy được giấu trong lều của hắn, bạc ở bên dưới.
vi.R: Vậy Giô-suê sai mấy người đi, và họ chạy đến lều của A-can. Các vật ấy ở đó, được giấu trong lều, bạc ở dưới cùng.

ko.L: 그러자 여호수아가 사자들을 보냈고, 그들이 그 장막으로 달려갔다. 보라, 그것이 그의 장막 안에 감추어져 있었고, 은은 그 밑에 있었다.
ko.B: 여호수아가 사람들을 보내니, 그들이 그 장막으로 달려갔다. 과연 그것이 그의 장막 안에 감추어져 있었고, 은은 맨 밑에 있었다.
ko.R: 여호수아가 사람들을 보내자, 그들이 아간의 장막으로 달려갔다. 정말 그 물건들이 장막 안에 숨겨져 있었고, 은은 맨 밑에 있었다.

pt.L: E Josué enviou mensageiros, e eles correram à tenda; e eis que [estava] escondido na sua tenda, e a prata debaixo dele.
pt.B: Então Josué enviou mensageiros, e eles correram à tenda. Lá estava o manto, escondido na tenda de Acã, com a prata por baixo.
pt.R: Então Josué mandou alguns homens, e eles correram até a tenda de Acã. As coisas estavam lá, escondidas na tenda, com a prata no fundo.

decisions.choice: there, hidden: what they found matched Achan's words
decisions.reason: "Look" turns the reader's eyes to what the messengers saw. "Hidden" is feminine singular, matching the cloak, the item on top; everything was just as Achan had said (verse 21).

decisions.choice: Achan's tent / The things
decisions.reason: Readable names whose tent it was and what was found.

decisions.choice: Lá estava o manto (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "hidden" is feminine, matching the cloak (m1); Portuguese needs a subject where the English Balanced says "it", so Balanced names the cloak, and "a tenda de Acã" says whose tent, since "dele" could point to Joshua.

source.text: וַיִּקָּחוּם֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיְבִאוּם֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּצִּקֻ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they took them from [the] midst of the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all [the] sons of Israel, and they poured them out before Yahweh.

en.L: And they took them from the middle of the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and they poured them out before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They took the things out of the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, and laid them out before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: They took the things out of the tent and brought them to Joshua and all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Then they spread them out on the ground in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

sw.L: Wakavitoa katikati ya hema, wakaviletea Yoshua na wana wote wa Israeli, wakavimwaga mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Walivitoa ndani ya hema, wakavileta kwa Yoshua na Waisraeli wote, wakavipanga mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Walivitoa ndani ya hema, wakavileta kwa Yoshua na Waisraeli wote. Kisha wakavitandaza chini mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y los sacaron de en medio de la tienda y los llevaron a Josué y a todos los hijos de Israel, y los derramaron delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Sacaron las cosas de la tienda, se las llevaron a Josué y a todos los israelitas, y las pusieron delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Sacaron las cosas de la tienda y se las llevaron a Josué y a todos los israelitas. Después las extendieron en el suelo delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et ils les prirent du milieu de la tente et les apportèrent à Josué et à tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, et ils les répandirent devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils sortirent les objets de la tente, les apportèrent à Josué et à tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, et les étalèrent devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ils ont sorti les objets de la tente et les ont apportés à Josué et à tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Puis ils les ont étalés sur le sol devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Và họ lấy các vật ấy ra từ giữa lều và đem đến cho Giô-suê và hết thảy con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, và họ đổ chúng ra trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Họ lấy các vật ấy ra khỏi lều, đem đến cho Giô-suê và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, rồi bày ra trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Họ lấy các vật ấy ra khỏi lều và đem đến cho Giô-suê và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Rồi họ bày chúng ra trên đất trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그것들을 장막 한가운데서 꺼내어 여호수아와 모든 이스라엘 자손에게 가져와서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 쏟아 놓았다.
ko.B: 그들은 장막에서 그 물건들을 꺼내어 여호수아와 모든 이스라엘 자손에게 가져와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 펼쳐 놓았다.
ko.R: 그들은 장막에서 그 물건들을 꺼내어 여호수아와 모든 이스라엘 백성에게 가져왔다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞의 땅바닥에 펼쳐 놓았다.

pt.L: E os tiraram do meio da tenda e os trouxeram a Josué e a todos os filhos de Israel, e os derramaram diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Tiraram as coisas da tenda, levaram-nas a Josué e a todos os israelitas e as estenderam diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Eles tiraram as coisas da tenda e as levaram a Josué e a todos os israelitas. Depois as espalharam no chão diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: poured them out before the LORD: laid them out in the LORD's presence
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to pour. Here the goods are spread out on the ground for all to see, before the ark (verse 6). What was stolen from the LORD is handed back to him.

decisions.choice: laid them out / spread them out
decisions.reason: "Poured" would suggest a liquid; Balanced and Readable say what was done with the goods (m1).

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת־עָכָ֣ן בֶּן־זֶ֡רַח וְאֶת־הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְאֶת־הָאַדֶּ֣רֶת וְֽאֶת־לְשׁ֣וֹן הַזָּהָ֡ב וְֽאֶת־בָּנָ֡יו וְֽאֶת־בְּנֹתָ֡יו וְאֶת־שׁוֹרוֹ֩ וְאֶת־חֲמֹר֨וֹ וְאֶת־צֹאנ֤וֹ וְאֶֽת־אָהֳלוֹ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּ֑וֹ וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם עֵ֥מֶק עָכֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Joshua Achan son of Zerah and the silver and the cloak and [the] tongue of the gold and his sons and his daughters and his ox and his donkey and his flock and his tent and all that [belonged] to him, and all Israel with him, and they brought them up [to the] valley of Achor.

en.L: And Joshua took Achan son of Zerah, and the silver and the cloak and the tongue of gold, and his sons and his daughters, and his oxen and his donkeys and his flock, and his tent, and all that [was] his, and all Israel with him; and they brought them up [to the] Valley of Achor.
en.B: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, seized Achan son of Zerah, together with the silver, the cloak and the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent, and all that he owned, and they led them up to the Valley of Achor.
en.R: Then Joshua and all the people of Israel took Achan, a descendant of Zerah. They took the silver, the coat and the bar of gold. They also took his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent, and everything else he owned. They brought them all to the Valley of Achor.

sw.L: Yoshua akamtwaa Akani mwana wa Zera, na ile fedha na lile joho na ule ulimi wa dhahabu, na wanawe na binti zake, na ng'ombe wake na punda wake na kondoo wake, na hema lake, na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, na Israeli wote pamoja naye; wakawapandisha hadi Bonde la Akori.
sw.B: Kisha Yoshua, pamoja na Israeli wote, walimkamata Akani mwana wa Zera, pamoja na ile fedha, lile joho na kile kipande cha dhahabu, wanawe na binti zake, ng'ombe wake, punda wake na kondoo wake, hema lake na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, wakawapeleka hadi Bonde la Akori.
sw.R: Kisha Yoshua na watu wote wa Israeli walimchukua Akani, mzao wa Zera. Walichukua ile fedha, lile koti na kile kipande cha dhahabu. Walichukua pia wanawe na binti zake, ng'ombe wake, punda wake na kondoo wake, hema lake, na kila kitu kingine alichokuwa nacho. Wakawapeleka wote hadi Bonde la Akori.

es.L: Y Josué tomó a Acán hijo de Zara, y la plata y el manto y la lengua de oro, y a sus hijos y a sus hijas, y sus bueyes y sus asnos y sus ovejas, y su tienda, y todo lo que [era] suyo, y todo Israel con él; y los hicieron subir al valle de Acor.
es.B: Entonces Josué, y todo Israel con él, tomaron a Acán hijo de Zara, junto con la plata, el manto y la barra de oro, sus hijos y sus hijas, sus bueyes, asnos y ovejas, su tienda y todo lo que tenía, y los llevaron al valle de Acor.
es.R: Entonces Josué y todo el pueblo de Israel tomaron a Acán, descendiente de Zara. Tomaron la plata, el manto y la barra de oro. También tomaron a sus hijos y a sus hijas, sus bueyes, asnos y ovejas, su tienda y todo lo demás que tenía. Los llevaron a todos al valle de Acor.

fr.L: Et Josué prit Akân fils de Zérah, et l’argent et le manteau et la langue d’or, et ses fils et ses filles, et ses bœufs et ses ânes et son petit bétail, et sa tente, et tout ce qui [était] à lui, et tout Israël avec lui ; et ils les firent monter [à] la vallée d’Akor.
fr.B: Alors Josué, et tout Israël avec lui, se saisit d’Akân fils de Zérah, ainsi que de l’argent, du manteau et du lingot d’or, de ses fils et de ses filles, de ses bœufs, de ses ânes et de ses moutons, de sa tente et de tout ce qu’il possédait, et ils les firent monter à la vallée d’Akor.
fr.R: Alors Josué et tout le peuple d’Israël ont pris Akân, un descendant de Zérah. Ils ont pris l’argent, le manteau et le lingot d’or. Ils ont aussi pris ses fils et ses filles, ses bœufs, ses ânes et ses moutons, sa tente et tout ce qu’il possédait. Ils les ont tous emmenés dans la vallée d’Akor.

vi.L: Và Giô-suê bắt A-can con cháu Xê-rách, cùng bạc, áo choàng và thỏi vàng, các con trai và con gái hắn, bò, lừa và bầy chiên của hắn, lều hắn và mọi vật [thuộc] về hắn, và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ở với ông; và họ đem chúng lên thung lũng A-cô.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-suê và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên với ông bắt A-can con cháu Xê-rách, cùng với bạc, áo choàng và thỏi vàng, các con trai và con gái hắn, bò, lừa và chiên của hắn, lều hắn và mọi thứ hắn có, rồi dẫn tất cả lên thung lũng A-cô.
vi.R: Rồi Giô-suê và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên bắt A-can, con cháu Xê-rách. Họ lấy bạc, áo khoác và thỏi vàng. Họ cũng bắt các con trai và con gái hắn, lấy bò, lừa và chiên của hắn, lều hắn và mọi thứ khác hắn có. Họ đem tất cả đến thung lũng A-cô.

ko.L: 그러자 여호수아가 세라의 아들 아간과 그 은과 그 외투와 그 금 혀와 그의 아들들과 그의 딸들과 그의 소와 그의 나귀와 그의 양 떼와 그의 장막과 그에게 속한 모든 것을 잡았고, 온 이스라엘이 그와 함께하였다. 그리고 그들을 아골 골짜기로 끌고 올라갔다.
ko.B: 그때 여호수아와 온 이스라엘은 세라의 자손 아간을 붙잡았다. 그리고 그 은과 외투와 금덩이와 그의 아들딸들과 그의 소와 나귀와 양 떼와 그의 장막과 그에게 속한 모든 것을 함께 가지고 아골 골짜기로 끌고 올라갔다.
ko.R: 그때 여호수아와 모든 이스라엘 백성은 세라의 자손 아간을 붙잡았다. 그들은 은과 외투와 금덩이를 가져갔다. 또 아간의 아들딸들과 소와 나귀와 양 떼와 장막, 그리고 그가 가진 다른 모든 것도 가져갔다. 그들은 그 모두를 아골 골짜기로 끌고 갔다.

pt.L: E Josué tomou Acã, filho de Zerá, e a prata, e o manto, e a língua de ouro, e os seus filhos, e as suas filhas, e os seus bois, e os seus jumentos, e o seu rebanho, e a sua tenda, e tudo o que [era] dele, e todo o Israel com ele; e os fizeram subir ao vale de Acor.
pt.B: Então Josué e todo o Israel com ele pegaram Acã, filho de Zerá, junto com a prata, o manto e a barra de ouro, os seus filhos e as suas filhas, o seu gado, os seus jumentos e as suas ovelhas, a sua tenda e tudo o que ele tinha, e os levaram até o vale de Acor.
pt.R: Então Josué e todo o povo de Israel pegaram Acã, um descendente de Zerá. Pegaram a prata, o manto e a barra de ouro. Pegaram também os filhos e as filhas dele, o seu gado, os seus jumentos e as suas ovelhas, a sua tenda e tudo o mais que ele tinha. Eles levaram tudo até o vale de Acor.

decisions.choice: Achan son of Zerah: a descendant of Zerah
decisions.reason: Zerah was Achan's distant ancestor (verse 1); "son" here means descendant.

decisions.choice: his sons and his daughters: whether they shared his punishment
alternatives: the family was put to death with Achan
the family was brought to watch the judgment
decisions.reason: The family is brought out with the animals and goods, and verse 25 says "they burned them" and "stoned them". This may mean the household died with Achan, as when a whole household was destroyed with its head (Numbers 16:27-33); hiding the goods in the family tent may have made them party to the crime. Others read the family as brought only to witness, since the Law forbids putting children to death for a father's sin (Deuteronomy 24:16), and take "them" in verse 25 to mean Achan's goods and animals. The text does not settle it.

decisions.choice: his ox, his donkey, his flock: all his animals
decisions.reason: The singular nouns stand for whole kinds of animal: his cattle, his donkeys and his sheep and goats. Everything Achan owned is treated as devoted (verse 15).

decisions.choice: the Valley of Achor: a valley leading up from the Jordan plain
decisions.reason: The valley lay on the edge of the land near Jericho; it later marked the border of Judah (15:7). Its name is explained in verse 26.

decisions.choice: cattle / sheep
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plural or group words for the animals (m3). "Flock" can mean sheep and goats; "sheep" is used as the common word.

decisions.choice: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, seized ...
decisions.reason: Balanced moves "and all Israel with him" next to Joshua, the subject, so the long list does not separate them.

decisions.choice: Josué e todo o Israel com ele pegaram (B)
alternatives: Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, pegou
decisions.reason: Balanced moves "all Israel with him" next to Joshua, as the English Balanced does (r-en-2), and Portuguese then makes the verb plural, since "e os levaram" that follows has the whole people as subject.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ מֶ֣ה עֲכַרְתָּ֔נוּ יַעְכֳּרְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶ֔בֶן וַיִּשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתָם֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּסְקְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲבָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua, Why have you troubled us? Will trouble you Yahweh on this day. And stoned him all Israel [with] stone, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

en.L: And Joshua said, "Why have you troubled us? {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will trouble you this day." And all Israel stoned him with stones; and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.
en.B: Joshua said, "Why have you brought trouble on us? {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will bring trouble on you today." Then all Israel stoned him; they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.
en.R: Joshua said, "Why have you brought all this trouble on us? Now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring trouble on you today." Then all the people of Israel threw stones at Achan until he died. They burned them with fire and also threw stones at them.

sw.L: Yoshua akasema, "Kwa nini umetutaabisha? {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakutaabisha wewe siku hii." Israeli wote wakampiga kwa mawe; wakawateketeza kwa moto, wakawapiga kwa mawe.
sw.B: Yoshua alisema, "Kwa nini umetuletea taabu? {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea taabu leo." Kisha Israeli wote walimpiga kwa mawe; wakawachoma moto, wakawapiga kwa mawe.
sw.R: Yoshua alisema, "Kwa nini umetuletea taabu hii yote? Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuletea taabu leo." Kisha watu wote wa Israeli walimpiga Akani kwa mawe mpaka akafa. Wakawachoma moto, na pia wakawapiga kwa mawe.

es.L: Y Josué dijo: «¿Por qué nos has traído desgracia? {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te traerá desgracia en este día». Y todo Israel lo apedreó con piedras; y los quemaron con fuego y los apedrearon con piedras.
es.B: Josué dijo: «¿Por qué nos has traído desgracia? {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te traerá desgracia hoy». Entonces todo Israel lo apedreó; los quemaron con fuego y los apedrearon.
es.R: Josué dijo: «¿Por qué nos has traído toda esta desgracia? Ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te traerá desgracia a ti hoy». Entonces todo el pueblo de Israel le tiró piedras a Acán hasta que murió. Los quemaron con fuego y también les tiraron piedras.

fr.L: Et Josué dit : « Pourquoi nous as-tu porté malheur ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te portera malheur en ce jour. » Et tout Israël le lapida avec des pierres ; et ils les brûlèrent au feu et les lapidèrent avec des pierres.
fr.B: Josué dit : « Pourquoi nous as-tu attiré le malheur ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’attirera le malheur aujourd’hui. » Alors tout Israël le lapida ; on les brûla au feu et on les lapida.
fr.R: Josué a dit : « Pourquoi nous as-tu attiré tout ce malheur ? Maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va t’attirer le malheur aujourd’hui. » Alors tout le peuple d’Israël a jeté des pierres sur Akân jusqu’à ce qu’il meure. Ils les ont brûlés et leur ont aussi jeté des pierres.

vi.L: Và Giô-suê nói: "Tại sao ngươi đã mang tai họa đến cho chúng ta? Ngày nay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ mang tai họa đến cho ngươi." Và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ném đá hắn; và họ thiêu chúng bằng lửa và ném đá chúng.
vi.B: Giô-suê nói: "Tại sao ngươi đã mang tai họa đến cho chúng ta? Hôm nay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên ngươi." Rồi cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ném đá hắn; họ thiêu chúng bằng lửa và ném đá chúng.
vi.R: Giô-suê nói: "Tại sao ngươi đã mang bao nhiêu tai họa đến cho chúng ta? Bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên ngươi hôm nay." Rồi toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ném đá A-can cho đến chết. Họ thiêu chúng bằng lửa và cũng ném đá chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 말했다. "어찌하여 네가 우리를 괴롭게 하였느냐? 오늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 괴롭게 하실 것이다." 그러자 온 이스라엘이 그를 돌로 쳤다. 그리고 그들을 불로 태우고 돌로 쳤다.
ko.B: 여호수아가 말했다. "어찌하여 네가 우리에게 재앙을 불러왔느냐? 오늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 재앙을 내리실 것이다." 그러자 온 이스라엘이 그를 돌로 쳤다. 그리고 그들을 불태우고 돌로 쳤다.
ko.R: 여호수아가 말했다. "어찌하여 네가 우리에게 이런 재앙을 불러왔느냐? 이제 오늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 재앙을 내리실 것이다." 그러자 모든 이스라엘 백성이 아간이 죽을 때까지 돌을 던졌다. 그리고 그들을 불태우고 또 돌로 쳤다.

pt.L: E Josué disse: "Por que você nos trouxe desgraça? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trará desgraça a você neste dia." E todo o Israel o apedrejou com pedras; e os queimaram no fogo e os apedrejaram com pedras.
pt.B: Josué disse: "Por que você trouxe desgraça sobre nós? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trará desgraça sobre você hoje." Então todo o Israel o apedrejou; eles os queimaram no fogo e os apedrejaram.
pt.R: Josué disse: "Por que você trouxe toda essa desgraça sobre nós? Agora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai trazer desgraça sobre você hoje." Então todo o povo de Israel atirou pedras em Acã até ele morrer. Eles os queimaram no fogo e também atiraram pedras neles.

decisions.choice: trouble: the word that gives the valley its name
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring disaster on someone, to stir up trouble. It sounds like the names Achan and Achor. Joshua had warned that taking devoted things would "trouble" the camp (6:18); now the one who troubled Israel is troubled in turn. See verse 26.

decisions.choice: him ... them: Achan, and those or what was taken with him
decisions.reason: "Him" is Achan. The plural "them" may mean his household, or his goods and animals together with his body; on the question of the family, see verse 24. Two different verbs for stoning are used, the second with the plural, so the stones may have been heaped over the burned remains as well.

decisions.choice: stoned and burned: execution by the whole people, then destruction by fire
decisions.reason: Stoning was carried out by the community together (Leviticus 24:14; Deuteronomy 13:10-11). Burning followed the command for one taken with the devoted things (verse 15).

decisions.choice: until he died
decisions.reason: Readable says that the stoning of Achan was an execution. It keeps the plural "them" in the next sentence, which leaves open who or what they were, as the Hebrew does (m2).

decisions.choice: brought trouble on
decisions.reason: "Troubled" sounds like mild worry in modern English; the verb means to bring disaster.

decisions.choice: "tai họa" for the verb "trouble", and Joshua now says "ngươi"
decisions.reason: The verb gives the valley its name (m1; verse 26), so Vietnamese keeps "tai họa" for it, as in 6:18. Joshua's word here is a sentence of judgment, not the fatherly "con" of verse 19, so it takes the distant "ngươi".

decisions.choice: "재앙을 불러오다 / 재앙을 내리다" (B, R) and "괴롭게 하다" (L) for the verb behind the name Achor
decisions.reason: The verb is the one that gives the Valley of Achor ("trouble") its name, so Korean uses the same word, "재앙", here and in the Readable explanation of the name in verse 26.

decisions.choice: trazer desgraça (every level)
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring disaster on someone (m1), and it gives the valley its name (verse 26). "Perturbar" would sound like mere annoyance, so every level says "trazer desgraça", the words Readable then uses to explain the name Acor.

source.text: וַיָּקִ֨ימוּ עָלָ֜יו גַּל־אֲבָנִ֣ים גָּד֗וֹל עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיָּ֥שָׁב יְהוָ֖ה מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֠ן קָרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ עֵ֣מֶק עָכ֔וֹר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they raised over him a heap of stones, great, until this day; and turned Yahweh from [the] burning of his anger. Therefore one called [the] name of that place Valley of Achor until this day.

en.L: And they raised over him a great heap of stones, [which is there] until this day; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} turned from the burning of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called [the] Valley of Achor until this day.
en.B: They raised a large pile of stones over him, which is there to this day. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} turned from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} burning anger. That is why the place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.
en.R: They piled a big heap of stones over Achan, and it is still there today. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was no longer angry. That is why the place is still called the Valley of Achor, which means Valley of Trouble.

sw.L: Wakainua juu yake rundo kubwa la mawe, [lililoko] hadi siku hii ya leo; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaacha ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kwa hiyo jina la mahali pale limeitwa Bonde la Akori hadi siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Waliinua juu yake rundo kubwa la mawe, ambalo liko hata leo. Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaiacha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali. Ndiyo sababu mahali pale pameitwa Bonde la Akori tangu wakati huo.
sw.R: Walirundika juu ya Akani rundo kubwa la mawe, nalo bado liko hadi leo. Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuwa na hasira tena. Ndiyo sababu mahali pale bado panaitwa Bonde la Akori, maana yake Bonde la Taabu.

es.L: Y levantaron sobre él un gran montón de piedras, [que está allí] hasta este día; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se apartó del ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira. Por eso el nombre de aquel lugar se ha llamado valle de Acor hasta este día.
es.B: Levantaron sobre él un gran montón de piedras, que sigue allí hasta el día de hoy. Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se apartó del ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira. Por eso aquel lugar se llama desde entonces valle de Acor.
es.R: Pusieron un gran montón de piedras sobre Acán, y todavía está allí hoy. Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejó de estar enojado. Por eso ese lugar todavía se llama valle de Acor, que significa «valle de la Desgracia».

fr.L: Et ils élevèrent sur lui un grand monceau de pierres, [qui est là] jusqu’à ce jour ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} revint de l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère. C’est pourquoi on a appelé le nom de ce lieu vallée d’Akor jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: On éleva sur lui un grand tas de pierres, qui est encore là aujourd’hui. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} revint de l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère. C’est pourquoi on appelle ce lieu la vallée d’Akor jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Ils ont entassé un gros tas de pierres sur Akân, et il est toujours là aujourd’hui. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a plus été en colère. C’est pour cela que l’endroit s’appelle encore la vallée d’Akor, ce qui veut dire « vallée du Malheur ».

vi.L: Và họ chất trên hắn một đống đá lớn, [còn] cho đến ngày nay; và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nguôi cơn giận phừng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì thế tên nơi ấy được gọi là thung lũng A-cô cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Họ chất trên hắn một đống đá lớn, vẫn còn đến ngày nay. Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nguôi cơn giận phừng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì thế nơi ấy được gọi là thung lũng A-cô cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Họ chất một đống đá lớn trên xác A-can, và đống đá ấy vẫn còn đến hôm nay. Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không còn giận nữa. Vì thế nơi ấy vẫn được gọi là thung lũng A-cô, nghĩa là "Thung Lũng Tai Họa".

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그 위에 큰 돌무더기를 쌓았는데, 그것이 오늘까지 있다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 불타는 진노를 거두셨다. 그러므로 그곳의 이름을 오늘까지 아골 골짜기라고 부른다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 위에 큰 돌무더기를 쌓았는데, 그것이 오늘까지 남아 있다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 불타는 진노를 거두셨다. 그래서 그곳을 오늘날까지 아골 골짜기라고 부른다.
ko.R: 그들은 아간 위에 큰 돌무더기를 쌓았는데, 그것이 지금도 그곳에 있다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 더 이상 노하지 않으셨다. 그래서 그곳은 지금도 아골 골짜기라고 불린다. 아골은 "재앙"이라는 뜻이다.

pt.L: E levantaram sobre ele um grande monte de pedras, [que está lá] até este dia; e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se afastou do ardor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira. Por isso o nome daquele lugar foi chamado vale de Acor até este dia.
pt.B: Levantaram sobre ele um grande monte de pedras, que está lá até hoje. Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se afastou do ardor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira. Por isso aquele lugar se chama vale de Acor até hoje.
pt.R: Eles fizeram um grande monte de pedras sobre Acã, e ele está lá até hoje. Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deixou de estar irado. É por isso que o lugar ainda se chama vale de Acor, que quer dizer vale da Desgraça.

decisions.choice: Valley of Achor: the name means "valley of trouble"
decisions.reason: Achor comes from the same root as the verb "trouble" in verse 25, so the place name recalls what happened there: Achan troubled Israel and was himself troubled. 1 Chronicles 2:7 even calls him Achar, "the troubler of Israel". The prophets later promise that this valley of trouble will become a place of rest and a door of hope (Isaiah 65:10; Hosea 2:17).

decisions.choice: a heap of stones until this day: a memorial still seen when the book was written
decisions.reason: Heaps of stones marked places where something important had happened (4:9; 8:29; Genesis 31:46-48). "Until this day" means the heap could still be seen in the writer's time. This heap stands in contrast to the memorial stones of the Jordan crossing (4:9).

decisions.choice: the LORD turned from his burning anger: the wrath of verse 1 is ended
decisions.reason: The chapter opens with the LORD's anger burning against Israel and closes with it turned away, once the devoted things were removed (verses 12-13). The way is open for victory at Ai (8:1).

decisions.choice: one called: the place came to be called
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it means the place was given this name, and the name stuck.

decisions.choice: which means Valley of Trouble
decisions.reason: Readable adds the meaning of the name, since the point of the verse is the wordplay (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the name and leave the meaning to the note.

decisions.choice: was no longer angry
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "turned from his burning anger" means.

decisions.choice: o vale de Acor (L, B); o vale de Acor, que quer dizer vale da Desgraça (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "o vale de Acor", with "vale" in lowercase as Portuguese writes a common noun before a name. The name sounds like the verb of verse 25 (m1), which Portuguese says as "trazer desgraça" at every level; Readable explains the name with the same word, "vale da Desgraça", so the wordplay is kept, as the English Readable does (r-en-1). Literal and Balanced keep the name and leave the meaning to the note.
